original_product_snapshot.name: organic body LOTION
original_product_snapshot.description:
A very moisturizing blend containing certified organic oils including sunflower, shea, jojoba & olive and organic extracts of chamomile, green tea, lavender and aloe vera to make the ultimate luxury lotion - your skin will love you for it!

- 100% vegetarian ingredients. All our products are cruelty free... tested on friends, not animals.

- No parabens or phthalates.

- Packaged in an amber bottle with a pump top

- Size: 8 fl oz / 236 mL

*scents marked with an asterisk are our pure essential oil blends.  

Ingredients: Purified water with infusion of certified organic botanical extracts of Lavandula Angustifolia (lavender)*, Matricaria Recutita (chamomile)*, Calendula Officinalis (calendula)*, Camellia Sinensis (green tea)*, Aloe Barbadensis (aloe leaf juice)*, Helianthus Annuus (sunflower oil)*, Butyrospermum Parkii (shea butter)*, Olea Europaea (olive oil)*, Linum Usitatissimum (flax seed oil)*, Simmondsia Chinensis (jojoba oil)*, Sesamum Indicum (sesame oil)*, Octyl Palmitate (esther of palm oil), Vegetable Glycerin, Glyceryl Stearate, Cetyl Alcohol, Stearyl Alcohol, Fragrance, Ceteareth-20, Tocopherol (vitamin E), Polysorbate 60, Dimethicone, Triethanolamine (pH neutralizer), Diazolidinyl Urea and Iodopropynyl Butylcarbamate. * Denotes certified organic ingredient

 

****Wholesale customers ****

Lotion must be ordered in case packs of 6 per fragrance.
